errors.evidence: The description of the vertical axis omits its unit '(in 1.000)', which is part of the axis label 'Zahl Entlastete (in 1.000)'.

The description uses words like 'ungefähr' (approximately) and 'etwa' (about) to describe the bar values. However, the values are explicitly labeled on the chart (90, 900, 1110, etc.) and are therefore exact, not approximate.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in aufsteigender Reihenfolge angeordnet, basierend auf dem untersten Wert jeder Einkommensspanne.
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly claims the bars are arranged in ascending order. The heights of the bars (90, 900, 1110, 940, 200, 20) are not in ascending order. The statement seems to confuse the ordering of the x-axis categories (which are sorted by income) with the sorting of the bars by height.
